title: Ayyanar Thunai
episodeTitle: Cheran Prepares to Reveal the Truth
description: Chandayatha leads a Pooja and ends her fast. As Chozhan teases Nila, she urges Nadesan to stay home before Cheran exposes the truth about Chandayatha's pregnancy

title: Azhagae Azhagu
episodeTitle: Malar, Bagyaraj Long for Each Other
description: Karthi calls Swetha to learn about the conflict at Malar's in-laws' home, and they share a joyful conversation. Malar and Bagyaraj grieve their separation, longing for each other.

title: Bigg Boss
episodeTitle: BBTam Day 40: Bigg Boss Award Night
description: Tempers flare as Avinash flings Jason’s clothes and Ansar steps in with punishments. Ansar probes the damage, not knowing Karishma did it. Later, BB Awards light up the night.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Savithri suspects Eshwari as Tamizhselvi confirms Sethupathi is innocent in the camp issue. Tensions escalate when villagers curse him and gather to wreck Rajangam's home.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Karthik takes Kasthuri out to enjoy a meal at a restaurant. After dining, he realises he forgot his money and gets beaten when the restaurant staff refuse to hear him.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Rajeshwari angrily defends Vennila, leaving the family to address business funds. Anbu and Kanmani go to court counselling, where she is urged to rethink her divorce.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Shanmugam's desperate plea moves Abhi, leading to their reunion after their breakup. Murugan consoles Indhira as she struggles with her decision to quit her delivery job.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Sakthivel grows anxious as the doctor reports no improvement in Muthuvel's health. Senthil interferes in Kathir's travel business to support Raji, but raises trip charges.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Meena is moved seeing Chandra at the temple and dreams of eating food in Chandra's hands. Meanwhile, Vijaya visits a matrimonial office for Manoj's wedding.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: A court official arrives at Abinaya's home to verify her compliance with the court order. Abinaya fears being exposed when the official questions Sudar about her compliance.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Worried about Poongodi's vengeance against Mayandi's family, Pechi receives a divine oracle to end the feud. Soon, her atonement paves the way to reveal the truth to Poongodi.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Hoping to ruin Paraman and Ilamathi's wedding night, Kalamma cuts the power. However, Nalini sends them to their room with candles, allowing their romance to continue.
